scenarios.title: Pressure to rewrite a slow list from intuition
scenarios.prompt: Scrolling is janky. Replace every computed property with cached state and add Equatable to all views without profiling.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Performs broad speculative rewrites that can add stale state and hide the actual update source.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Reviews state flow and expensive body work first, requests focused profiling when code evidence is insufficient, and changes only the measured bottleneck.

scenarios.title: Performance improvement claimed from unmatched runs
scenarios.prompt: The optimized build looked smoother on a different simulator and data set, so report the regression fixed.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Claims success from subjective, non-comparable observations.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Repeats the same workload under comparable conditions, records relevant timing or rendering evidence, and reports remaining uncertainty instead of overstating the result.

scenarios.title: Start from the supplied trace
scenarios.prompt: I supplied a symbolicated trace for the janky scroll flow and the matching source. Diagnose the hot stack; do not start a new intake interview.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Forces code-first intake and asks the user to classify symptoms or recapture already available evidence.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Starts with the supplied trace, relates it to the source, and requests additional evidence only for a specific unresolved question.
